sources.quote: Load a Game Pak into the top of the Control Deck as shown. Push it down all the way.
AC ADAPTER JACK / RF SWITCH JACK / Plug the NES controller(s) into the sockets on the front of the Control Deck as shown. / SOCKET #2 / SOCKET #1
Slide the power switch to the on position. / Push the reset button and release.
Make sure the power switch of the Control Deck is in the off position.

notes: Scan of Nintendo of America's 1993 NES (top-loading Control Deck) instruction booklet, archive.org item toploaderinstructionbooklet ('© 1993 Nintendo of America Inc.'); every quote is that scan's OCR text layer, clean lines only. The booklet prints no dimensions or mass: body null.
media: 'Load a Game Pak into the top of the Control Deck' → cartridge_top 1.

ports: NES COMPONENTS (rear) lists AC ADAPTER JACK → power_in 1 and RF SWITCH JACK → rf_out 1; the controller section shows SOCKET #1 and SOCKET #2 on the front → controller_proprietary 2. No audio/video jack appears anywhere in the booklet. The 'CH 3- CH 4 SWITCH' is listed; its form is not printed, so it is not mapped to slide_switch.
controls: 'Slide the power switch' → power_switch; 'Push the reset button' → reset_button.
